note: Declarative curation for the metro data engine (scripts/metro-engine.mjs). The ONLY place human knowledge about a city's network lives — facts the pipeline cannot derive from OSM tags. Every rule has a ruleId (stamped into shipped meta.curationApplied) and a reason. Never encode these as code.

excludeNamePatterns.reason: Phase-2 service pattern, not operational. User-confirmed 2026-07-04 that Chennai runs only Blue + Green lines; OSM tags these relations as operational with no lifecycle marker, so the tag filter cannot catch them.

renameLines.reason: OSM names the Meerut local metro service (Modipuram ⇔ Meerut South, running on the RRTS corridor) just 'Line 1' — ambiguous inside Delhi's file, where nothing else says which system it belongs to.

excludeRelations.reason: Mumbai Metro Line 11 (Wadala–CSMT) is under construction, not operational. OSM tags the relation route=subway with no lifecycle marker; corroborating evidence: no route_master groups it and it carries zero role-tagged stop members. It shipped in the pre-engine data only because the original fetch had no lifecycle filtering.

renameStations.reason: OSM node 5737097412 is named 'Khargar Village' — a spelling variant of the same station as node 5501092823 ('Kharghar Village'), 5m apart. Renaming lets the two stop nodes merge into one station instead of rendering as two.
